token.title: Existing Mobile Pass
token.description: Provide your matching OAuth application credentials and an existing Mobile Pass refresh token. Credentials stay on this Home Assistant server.

invitation.title: New Mobile Pass invitation
invitation.description: Submitting redeems this invitation once. An invitation used by your phone cannot be reused. Tokens are saved before discovery; resubmitting the same values recovers a completed redemption.

error.invalid_auth: Brivo rejected these credentials or invitation. Verify the application credentials and authorization.
error.cannot_connect: Could not complete setup. Saved credentials can be recovered by submitting the same values.

abort.already_configured: This Mobile Pass is already configured.
abort.invitation_uncertain: This invitation was already attempted without saved tokens. It will not be retried. Use a saved refresh token or obtain a fresh invitation.

check_connection.name: Check connection
check_connection.description: Validate saved credentials and refresh tokens if necessary. Does not open any access point.

config_entry_id.name: Integration
config_entry_id.description: Select an integration when multiple passes are configured.
